landing.subtitle: Asali Club Digital Jukwaa
landing.description: Kuinua ufugaji nyuki wa Kiafrika kuwa sekta ya hadhi ya kimataifa. Tunawaunganisha wafugaji nyuki wenye shauku moja kwa moja na masoko ya kimataifa ya ubora wa juu kupitia ufuatiliaji wa kidijitali na ubora ulioidhinishwa.
landing.pillars_subtitle: Imejengwa kwa teknolojia ya kiwango cha biashara ili kuwawezesha wakulima wadogo na kuhakikisha uaminifu wa watumiaji.
landing.traceability_desc: Uwazi wa msururu wa ugavi unaotegemea msitu hadi jedwali wa QR unaoendeshwa na Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) na uwekaji alama wa ubora unaoendeshwa na AI.
landing.market_desc: Kuepuka wafanyabiashara wa kati wa jadi ili kuwapa wafugaji nyuki wa ndani uwezeshaji wa mauzo ya moja kwa moja kwa masoko ya juu katika Ghuba, EU, na Asia.
landing.inclusion_desc: Seamless Mobile Money (M-Pesa) ushirikiano na utawala unaoendeshwa na vyama vya ushirika ili kuwawezesha kifedha wakulima wadogo.
landing.journey_subtitle: Mchakato sanifu na wa uwazi unaohakikisha asali ya hali ya juu pekee ndiyo inafika soko la kimataifa.
landing.step1_desc: Wafugaji nyuki hujiandikisha kupitia portal na kukamilisha mafunzo ya lazima ya ubora.
landing.step2_desc: Asali huvunwa kutoka kwa nyuki zilizokaguliwa na kupewa kitambulisho cha kundi la kidijitali cha QR.
landing.step3_desc: Vikundi hufanyiwa majaribio makali ya kimaabara ili kufikia Ukadiriaji wetu wa umiliki wa Nyota 1-5.
landing.step4_desc: Asali iliyoidhinishwa inasafirishwa kwa usalama kwa watumiaji wanaolipiwa duniani kote.
landing.cta_title: Je, uko tayari kujiunga na Klabu ya Asali?
landing.cta_subtitle: Weka tarakimu za biashara yako ya ufugaji nyuki leo. Usajili huchukua chini ya dakika 5.

shop.description: Bidhaa zote zimehakikiwa, kuthibitishwa, na kupewa chapa na Honey Club Limited. Kutoka kwa mzinga hadi nyumbani kwako.
shop.adjust_filters: Jaribu kurekebisha vichujio vyako au hoja ya utafutaji.

register.title: Join the Honey Club
register.subtitle: Register as a beekeeper to digitize your business. A field survey will be scheduled after your application is verified.
register.consumer_subtitle: Register as a member to start shopping for premium, certified honey.
register.step1_desc: Set up your login credentials and tell us about yourself
register.step2_desc: Tell us where you are based for the field survey
register.independent: No, I am an Independent Beekeeper
register.what_next_desc: After registration, an admin will review your application and schedule a field survey. During the survey, a field officer will verify your identity, assess your experience, and register your hives.
register.delivery_desc: Tell us where you want your honey delivered

membership.subtitle: Fungua ufikiaji wa kipekee wa vikundi adimu vya asali, mapunguzo ya kwanza na matumizi ya VIP.
